message: The other day, I found myself in a classic 'I told you so' moment. My grandson rolled his eyes as I insisted we stock up on some extra bottled water ahead of the storm. Fast forward to the night of the blizzard, and there we were, cozy inside with our well-stocked supplies while the world outside turned into a winter wonderland. Maybe it’s just me, but there’s something satisfying about being prepared while others are scrambling. It’s those little moments that remind me that a bit of planning can go a long way. 🌨️
